'''Gila Yarg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tarasin]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tarasin]], Gila Yarg was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], studying independently in the ways of the [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]] after achieving [[Jedi Knight/Legends|knighthood]]. In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Yarg attended the [[SoroSuub Anniversary celebration, 31 BBY|SoroSuub Anniversary celebration]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. He was one of a number of Jedi representing the [[Almas Academy]], an experimental [[Jedi academy]] located on the nearby planet [[Almas]], during the event.<ref name="BA" />
